description: Blocks popups on every site: window.open, target=_blank links/forms (including detached/programmatic ones), synthetic clicks, href-swapped and full-screen overlay popunder links, and pristine window.open grabbed from fresh iframes. Shows a 'Popup blocked' pill on the page; tap to expand and open any blocked popup. Strict/Smart modes and a per-site allowlist.
name: Popup Blocker for Orion
